# Registration Checklist: WARP Registration & Endpoint Scan

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of identity registration, renewal, and MASQUE enrollment requirements
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are registration requirements defined for all three consumers (WARP hop, GOOL outer hop, GOOL inner hop)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 Are MASQUE enrollment requirements defined separately from WARP registration, including the dependency order? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, US-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are license-key acceptance requirements defined for all three input paths (flag, prompt, file)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Are auto-registration-on-connect requirements defined, including what the user is told when it happens? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK005 Are explicit-renewal requirements defined for the refused, healthy, and midway-failure cases? [Completeness, Spec §US-003]
- [ ] CHK006 Are device key generation requirements defined (who generates, what kind, where it first exists)? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the set of "explicit provider-refusal signals" enumerated exhaustively, or only exemplified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the MASQUE rotation window quantified (lifetime length, renew-before margin)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "refresh-in-place" defined as distinct observable behavior from "fresh re-registration"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "unrelated settings untouched" scoped — which settings exactly are preserved across renewal? [Clarity, Spec §US-003, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the "exactly one identity wins" race rule specified with a deterministic outcome? [Clarity, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are FR-003 (auto-register when none stored) and FR-004 (renew only on refusal) consistent about when registration fires? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the Edge Cases revocation bullet agree with FR-004 on automatic vs offered renewal? [Consistency, Edge Cases, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Are GOOL outer/inner independence requirements consistent between FR-009 and the data-model GoolPair? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the license key's "used but never persisted" rule consistent with the refused-identity retry path (is the key re-asked or reused in memory)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-004]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can SC-001 (registered in under 60 seconds) be objectively measured, and is "unblocked network" defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 Can SC-004 (renewed with settings untouched) be objectively verified, including the refused-identity fixture shape? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Are US-001 acceptance scenarios 1–4 each independently testable without the others? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US-001]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for renewing a healthy identity explicitly (no-op confirmation path)? [Coverage, Spec §US-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for corrupt/partial identity stores on every read path, not just startup? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for mid-session revocation detection timing (when is refusal noticed)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for an invalid/expired license key (rejected key vs refused identity)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for registration attempts while a session using the old identity is still up? [Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 Are dual-stack requirements specified for the registration channel itself (not just data hops)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is the assumption of a stable provider registration API shape validated with a fallback if it changes? [Assumption]

## Re-sweep (post-analyze, 2026-09-16)

- [ ] CHK092 Is the "never echoed" license rule reconcilable between Spec §FR-010 and the echoing TTY prompt documented in contracts/cli.md, or do the two artifacts contradict each other? [Conflict, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK093 Are pair-renewal requirements consistent between Spec §FR-009 ("only when explicitly asked for both"), the `--hop both` default in contracts/cli.md, and T027's "hop named by the chain" default? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK094 Is the explicit provider-refusal signal set enumerated exhaustively in the requirements, or only exemplified ("unknown, revoked, or gone")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK095 Is the MASQUE rotation window quantified in the requirements (lifetime length, renew-before margin), or fixed only in code-adjacent artifacts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK096 Are pre-connect notice requirements defined — which inline events (registration, refresh, rotation, deferral) must surface to the user, and on which channel? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK097 Are re-enrollment-hint requirements defined for identities whose MASQUE credential is lost to re-registration? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK098 Are GOOL sibling-renewal requirements user-observable — is it specified what the user sees when only one hop of a pair is renewed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK099 Is the user-notification requirement for inline auto-registration specified (what the user is told when connect registers on their behalf, and where)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
